nodes.name: espn_nba_calendar.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the ESPN NBA calendar endpoint, returning the league's season calendar (date ranges and season types) as a tidy tibble.

nodes.name: espn_nba_coach.R
nodes.summary: Fetches single-coach detail and per-coach win/loss records from ESPN's NBA Core v2 coach endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_nba_data.R
nodes.summary: Core ESPN NBA game-data module providing play-by-play, team/player box scores, rosters, schedules, scoreboard, standings, betting, and team/player stats from ESPN Site v2 game summaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the batch (~4k lines, 15 exported functions); heavy janitor/tidyr/purrr flattening of deeply nested ESPN JSON.

nodes.name: espn_nba_event_detail.R
nodes.summary: Per-event (game) detail scrapers covering ESPN NBA odds, win probabilities, officials, broadcasts, predictors, prop bets, linescores, leaders, rosters, and team statistics.
nodes.languageNotes: 19 exported per-event helper functions sharing the ESPN Core v2 event reference shape.

nodes.name: espn_nba_franchise.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves the ESPN NBA franchises index and single-franchise detail records (franchise identity, venue, colors) from Core v2 endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_nba_futures.R
nodes.summary: Returns ESPN NBA season futures betting markets in long format from the Core v2 futures endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_nba_groups_v2.R
nodes.summary: Season-scoped group hierarchy scrapers for ESPN NBA: groups index, single group, child groups, and group team membership.

nodes.name: espn_nba_groups.R
nodes.summary: Fetches the ESPN NBA conferences listing (Eastern/Western and their groupings) as a tidy tibble.

nodes.name: espn_nba_injuries.R
nodes.summary: Provides league-wide and per-team ESPN NBA injury reports resolved from Core v2 injury reference endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_nba_league.R
nodes.summary: League-level ESPN NBA reference scrapers: league leaders, venues, coaches index, athletes index, seasons list, and per-season info.

nodes.name: espn_nba_news.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves league-wide and team-specific ESPN NBA news articles from the Site v2 news endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_nba_positions.R
nodes.summary: Returns the ESPN NBA positions index and single-position detail from Core v2 position reference endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_nba_powerindex.R
nodes.summary: Fetches ESPN NBA season Basketball Power Index (BPI) ratings in long format from the Core v2 powerindex endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_nba_season_meta.R
nodes.summary: Season metadata scrapers for ESPN NBA: season types index/detail, season leaders, and season rankings index/detail.

nodes.name: espn_nba_team_deep.R
nodes.summary: Deep per-team ESPN NBA scrapers covering odds records, depth charts, season rosters, coach-by-season, and detailed records.

nodes.name: espn_nba_team_detail.R
nodes.summary: Per-team ESPN NBA detail scrapers: team identity, roster, schedule, leaders, season profile, and season statistics.

nodes.name: espn_nba_team_record.R
nodes.summary: Returns an ESPN NBA team's win/loss record broken out per season type from the Core v2 record endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_nba_tournaments.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes ESPN NBA tournament metadata: tournaments index, single tournament, and per-tournament season listings (e.g., In-Season Tournament).

nodes.name: espn_nba_transactions.R
nodes.summary: Provides ESPN NBA draft picks, free-agent listings, and roster transaction feeds parsed from Core v2 transaction endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_nba_weeks.R
nodes.summary: Season-week scrapers for ESPN NBA: weeks index, single week, and per-week rankings index/detail.

nodes.name: espn_nba_wp.R
nodes.summary: Builds NBA win-probability chart data per play from ESPN's game-summary win-probability feed.

nodes.name: fox_basketball.R
nodes.summary: Fox Sports basketball scrapers exposing parallel NBA and MBB functions for play-by-play, box scores, odds, rosters, team stats, and game logs.
nodes.languageNotes: 19 exported functions arranged as mirrored fox_nba_* / fox_mbb_* pairs over the Fox Sports JSON API.

nodes.name: hoopshype_salaries.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes HoopsHype player salary tables, returning multi-season NBA player salary figures as a tidy data frame.

nodes.name: kp_box_tables.R
nodes.summary: KenPom game-level scrapers parsing box scores and in-game win-probability tables from the (subscriber-gated) kenpom.com HTML pages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rvest/xml2/stringi to parse HTML tables behind a KenPom login session.

nodes.name: kp_historical_tables.R
nodes.summary: KenPom historical-data scrapers for team/coach efficiency history, program ratings, the Pomeroy archive ratings, and conference statistics tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest KenPom module (~1.3k lines); heavy rvest HTML-table parsing across many historical kenpom.com pages.
